description: Counted three books and sixty rolls and sat on them.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Gave the order of going, the yeoman, and the hanging.
name: George Bryan

description: Called the muster, named twenty-six shillings, and kept Garnish on the chest.
name: John Heminges

description: Stood in the room with the cup, and did not sing.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Asked whether Friday is the Queen or the chair again.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Produced the old heel and called himself satisfied.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Presented his feet and kept the boy off a song for today.
name: Will Kemp

description: Showed both heels, answered Sam, and left the four days unbroken.
name: William Shakespeare
